
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/20505331" title="发布于 2026-06-13 15:58">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">26. Agent 记不住业务数据？用 Store 给它加个“笔记本“！</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>Agent 通过 Checkpointer 记住对话上下文不是什么难事，但要是想让它存点“业务数据”——比如用户偏好、任务进度、历史操作记录这类东西——光靠 Checkpointer 就有点力不从心了。对话线程之间彼此隔离，换个线程就像失忆一样，之前积累的信息全用不上。Store 机制就是来解决这个问题的。你可以把它理解成 Agent 随身携带的一个“笔记本”：想记什么就记什么，以键值对的形式存进去，什么时候想查都能翻出来。更关键的是，这个笔记本不绑定某个具体的对话线程——不管 Agent 在哪个线程里工作，都能访问同一份数据，真正做到跨对话、跨线程的信息共享。</p>
<p>动画视频在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1AwJJ6GEwy/" rel="noopener nofollow">《26. Agent记不住业务数据？用 Store 给它加个"笔记本"！》</a>。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202606/1919157-20260613155631469-1767941577.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>光说不练假把式，我们直接上代码。</p>
<p>先从最简单的内存存储开始。我们创建一个 InMemoryStore 对象，把它传给 create_agent，这样 Agent 就具备了存储和查询业务数据的能力。存数据用 store.put() 方法，三个参数依次是命名空间元组、键名和值，命名空间可以理解为“文件夹”，用来对数据做分类管理。取数据用 store.get() 方法，传入命名空间和键名就能把之前存的内容读出来，不管隔了多少轮对话，只要键对得上数据就在那里。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">

</div>
<p>不过 InMemoryStore 有个明显的短板——数据全在内存里，程序一关就什么都没了。拿来做 demo 没问题，真正跑项目肯定不行。所以我们把数据落到 SQLite 数据库里，让它真正持久化。具体做法是复用同一个数据库文件 agent.db，新增一个 SqliteStore 连接专门保存业务数据。这里有个容易踩坑的地方：创建连接时必须加上 isolation_level=None 参数来禁用自动事务管理，因为 agent.db 同时被 Checkpointer 和 Store 共用，如果不禁用自动事务，两者操作起来很容易出现嵌套事务冲突。改动很小，把 InMemoryStore 换成 SqliteStore 就行。最后别忘了，程序结束时关闭数据库连接，释放资源。</p>

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">计算结果: {eval(expression)}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">计算错误: {str(e)}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 
    async </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> _arun(self, expression: str) -&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> str:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> self._run(expression)
 
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ========== 初始化工具 ==========</span>
calculate =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CalculateTool()
write_file </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WriteFileTool()
read_file </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ReadFileTool()
list_dir </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ListDirectoryTool()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 新增代码</span>
checkpoint_conn= sqlite3.connect(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">agent.db</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, check_same_thread=False, isolation_level=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">None)
checkpointer </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SqliteSaver(checkpoint_conn)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 新增代码</span>
store_conn = sqlite3.connect(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">agent.db</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, check_same_thread=False, isolation_level=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">None)
store </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SqliteStore(store_conn)
 
agent </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_agent(
    model</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">model,
    tools</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[calculate, write_file, read_file, list_dir],
    system_prompt</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是一个助手，会用工具计算、读写文件、列出目录。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    debug</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True,
    checkpointer</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">checkpointer,
    store</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">store
)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加配置</span>
config = {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">configurable</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">thread_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">session-1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用户资料</span>
store.put((<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user-1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>), <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">profile</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">张三</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">developer</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">skills</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">python</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">typescript</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">java</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
})
 
profile </span>= store.get((<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user-1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>), <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">profile</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">用户资料: {profile.value}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
 
 
queries </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> [
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">计算 2024*12+500，然后把结果保存到 result.txt</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">读取 result.txt 的内容</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">列出当前目录文件</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">刚才计算的结果是多少？</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
]
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> q <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> queries:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n问：{q}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    result </span>= agent.invoke({<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [{<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: q}]}, config=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">config)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">答：{result['messages'][-1].content}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 使用完毕后关闭连接</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">checkpoint_conn.close()
store_conn.close()</span></pre>
